name: FIFO Steering and Queue Bundling
description: Make queued user input behave as a pure FIFO queue: no mid-turn <system-reminder> steering, no per-mode bundling. Each queued message drains one-at-a-time as its own turn.

provenance.author: kendreaditya
provenance.license_note: MIT covers these patch scripts/definitions, NOT the patched Anthropic binary. Do not redistribute the patched binary.
provenance.derived_by: byte-fingerprinting the Bun binary against the v2.1.88 TypeScript source reference

marker.note: M3: introduce a dedicated /*ccx:fifo*/ comment marker decoupled from the behavioral edits below. Until then, per-op patched_anchor provides 3-state detection.

operations.rationale: Remove 'prompt' from INLINE_NOTIFICATION_MODES so user-typed messages are never emitted as queued_command attachments mid-turn. Keep 'task-notification' (load-bearing for background-agent / SleepTool wake-ups).
Force every queued command through the single-item dequeue path by making the bash-branch gate tautologically true ('bash' -> q.mode). Disables dequeueAllMatching bundling.
Stop the mid-turn removeFromQueue filter from matching prompt-mode commands, so they survive to drain as their own post-turn turns. Keep 'task-notification'.
